reason: Pay-when-happy is decent, but £655 plus £43 every month is over £1,100 in the first year, and I can knock something up on Wix or get a cheap freelancer for way less. Money's tight and a site isn't top of my list right now.
objection: The £43 a month that never stops. Once I'm on it I'm stuck paying forever for hosting and small fixes I could probably do myself, and it's a bloke abroad with no UK reviews.
would_change_my_mind: A one-off price around £300-£400 with no monthly care plan required, or cheap hosting I can run myself after handover.
